cut_en: extreme long shot, static camera, eye level: the empty embankment road running straight into thick dawn fog, no vehicle visible yet, reeds on both sides fading into gray, flat blue-gray diffused pre-dawn light with almost no shadows, quiet composition with the upper third of the panel left as empty misty sky for the title

outfit.dongmin: an oversized hand-me-down loose green cotton-knit tracksuit with a single contrasting stripe down the sides, baggy at the knees, elastic cuffs, no logo, plain white knitted cotton work gloves with no rubber coating, rubber boots

cut_en: medium shot, eye level: Eunju crouches on the left adjusting her cotton gloves, wiggling her toes inside her boots; Dongmin sits on the right hugging an empty sack, nodding off with his eyes shut; behind them on the slope the hook woman stands gripping her long iron hook, calling toward Eunju with her mouth open; flat blue-gray pre-dawn light, almost no shadows, empty space at upper right for a speech bubble

extreme close-up, side view: Eunju's left ear and profile with loose wisps of hair at the temple, her head tilting slightly to the left, eyes half-lowered and still, cold blue-gray pre-dawn light from the left, from the misty embankment road in the far background soft light rings travel toward her ear

bust shot, eye level: Eunju on the left answers calmly after a half-beat pause, eyes forward, mouth flat with no smile; behind her on the right the hook woman drops her shoulders in disappointment and lowers her hook, starting to sit back down on the slope; flat blue-gray pre-dawn light, soft mist between them

outfit.dongmin: an oversized hand-me-down loose green cotton-knit tracksuit with a single contrasting stripe down the sides, baggy at the knees, elastic cuffs, no logo, plain white knitted cotton work gloves with no rubber coating, rubber boots

cut_en: bust shot, eye level: Dongmin on the right has snapped his eyes wide open and asks earnestly, still half asleep, hugging his sack; Eunju on the left looks straight ahead; in the far background a small truck emerges from the fog on the embankment road, white painted lettering on its door as unreadable blank strokes suggesting text; flat blue-gray diffused light

medium shot, high angle: on the terraced slope several women scavengers in dark padded work clothes and head scarves giggle behind their hands, one in a red top and one in a blue top; in the left foreground the back of Eunju's head and shoulders, still and not laughing; flat blue-gray pre-dawn light

extreme close-up, eye level: Eunju's eyes, her head tilting again slightly to the left, gaze unfocused as she listens; a low heavy engine rumbles beyond the frame and beneath it scrap metal jingles; quiet composition, no glow effects; cold blue-gray pre-dawn light from the left

full shot, low angle: Eunju rises to her feet in the center, an empty sack hanging from her gloved hand, standing against the blue-gray dawn sky, face calm and certain, eyes looking down the slope toward the big hill; flat diffused light, a little mist around her boots

long shot, eye level, wide establishing shot of the whole slope: scavengers in dark work clothes with scattered red and blue tops scramble to their feet grabbing their sacks; in the right foreground the hook woman thrusts her long iron hook high into the air, shouting down the slope; flat blue-gray pre-dawn light, mist thinning

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: high-angle long shot from the middle terrace of the small hill looking down southeast to the foot of the big hill, a dump truck tilting its bed and pouring scrap iron, dust rising. Bottom: Eunju standing, medium close-up in left profile, an empty sack gripped in her gloved hand, lips moving silently as if counting, the falling metal sounds splitting into separate small glowing dots

outfit.dongmin: an oversized hand-me-down loose green cotton-knit tracksuit with a single contrasting stripe down the sides, baggy at the knees, elastic cuffs, no logo, plain white knitted cotton work gloves with no rubber coating, rubber boots

cut_en: medium shot, side view: children in work gloves and rubber boots run whooping down the slope; Eunju on the left runs clutching her sack and looks back over her shoulder as she speaks; Dongmin on the right runs after her holding the hem of her jacket; rubber boots splash through the mud; flat blue-gray light just beginning to warm

outfit.dongmin: an oversized hand-me-down loose green cotton-knit tracksuit with a single contrasting stripe down the sides, baggy at the knees, elastic cuffs, no logo, plain white knitted cotton work gloves with no rubber coating, rubber boots

cut_en: extreme long shot, high angle: two small figures run along the terraced slope toward the big trash hill, growing small in the frame; Dongmin tilts his head as he runs; on the left, above the big hill, the first ray of sunrise breaks through the fog; empty sky at the top for trailing speech bubbles that shrink downward

cut_en: long shot, low angle looking up the scrap heap: on the summit Mija plants a stick with a red rag tied to it, chin raised; two kids in dark clothes, work gloves and rubber boots stand behind her with arms crossed; in the foreground the backs of Eunju and Dongmin holding sacks, stopped at the foot of the heap; low morning sun from the left glinting on scrap metal

outfit.mija: a loose-fitting red cotton-knit tracksuit top with a single contrasting stripe down each sleeve, zip front, no logo, dark trousers, plain white knitted cotton work gloves with no rubber coating, rubber boots

cut_en: bust shot, slightly low angle: Mija on the upper right with her chin thrust up, the bandage on her nose pointing at the sky, arms crossed; Eunju on the lower left looks up at her after a half-beat pause, eyebrows level, mouth flat; low morning sun from the left, short metallic glints in the heap behind

outfit.deoksu: a blue plaid shirt over a stretched, slightly yellowed thin white cotton-knit sleeveless undershirt (a Korean 'running shirt', not an athletic tank top), plain white knitted cotton work gloves with no rubber coating, rubber boots

cut_en: medium shot, eye level: Deoksu sits leaning against the side of the scrap heap, chewing a piece of scorched rice crust he pulled from his shirt pocket, cheeks full, droopy eyes gazing at nothing in particular, looking at neither girl; relaxed slumped posture; low morning sun from the left

outfit.mija: a loose-fitting red cotton-knit tracksuit top with a single contrasting stripe down each sleeve, zip front, no logo, dark trousers, plain white knitted cotton work gloves with no rubber coating, rubber boots

cut_en: medium shot over Eunju's shoulder: the view sweeps across the scrap heap, a jumble of rusty iron, tin and mud-covered lumps; Mija on the upper right digs with her gloved hands and triumphantly holds up a shiny yellow lump of metal, mouth wide in a boast; two gloved kids behind her throw up their arms; low morning sun from the left making the yellow paint gleam

close-up of two gloved hands: a girl's hand taps a short iron rod lightly against the yellow-painted lump held in another gloved hand; from the point of contact a single flat, sharp ring of pale light flashes out and breaks off almost at once; surroundings desaturated; low morning sun from the left

outfit.mija: a loose-fitting red cotton-knit tracksuit top with a single contrasting stripe down each sleeve, zip front, no logo, dark trousers, plain white knitted cotton work gloves with no rubber coating, rubber boots

cut_en: medium shot, eye level: Eunju on the left lowers her iron rod, face calm; Mija in the center scratches the yellow lump with a gloved fingertip and the yellow paint flakes off to reveal dull black iron, her mouth falling open; in the right background Deoksu stops chewing and snorts a laugh; low morning sun from the left

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: medium shot, side view, Eunju walks along the heap tapping mud-covered lumps one by one with her iron rod, her head tilting a little more with each tap. Bottom: extreme close-up of her left ear and profile as she stops before one lump, a round soft ring of pale light swelling out and fading slowly with a long tail; surroundings desaturated

bust shot, eye level: Eunju on the left, head still tilted to the left, speaks quietly with her eyes on the mud-covered lump at her feet; from the right edge of the frame a gloved hand in a red sleeve shoots in and snatches the lump away; low morning sun from the left

outfit.mija: a loose-fitting red cotton-knit tracksuit top with a single contrasting stripe down each sleeve, zip front, no logo, dark trousers, plain white knitted cotton work gloves with no rubber coating, rubber boots

cut_en: insert shot: a red sleeve rubs the mud off the lump and reddish-brown copper gleams through, a bent piece of copper pipe in Mija's gloved hand; in the out-of-focus background one kid in dark clothes and work gloves whispers behind a hand, and Mija's head is whipping around toward him, scowling; low morning sun from the left catching the copper

outfit.deoksu: a blue plaid shirt over a stretched, slightly yellowed thin white cotton-knit sleeveless undershirt (a Korean 'running shirt', not an athletic tank top), plain white knitted cotton work gloves with no rubber coating, rubber boots

cut_en: medium shot, eye level: Deoksu on the right, still seated against the heap with a rice crust in hand, asks slowly while counting on his fingers, and his droopy eyes go round with wonder; Eunju on the left answers plainly, eyes level; low morning sun from the left

outfit.dongmin: an oversized hand-me-down loose green cotton-knit tracksuit with a single contrasting stripe down the sides, baggy at the knees, elastic cuffs, no logo, plain white knitted cotton work gloves with no rubber coating, rubber boots

cut_en: long shot, eye level: on the right Mija marches away shouting over her shoulder, the red rag flag carried high, two kids in work gloves and boots trailing her; in the middle Dongmin sticks his tongue out at her back; in the left foreground Eunju drops the copper piece into a half-empty sack, glances once at the sky across the river, then taps the heap again with her rod; morning sun from the left

long shot, eye level, wide establishing shot from the yard: old Kwak's corrugated-iron junk shop where the embankment road ends, scrap stacked in layers under the tin roof, the roof edge lifting in the wind; Eunju and Dongmin, school bags on their backs, walk toward the open front; clear spring afternoon light

medium shot, eye level: across the workbench old Kwak faces the camera; Eunju's gloved hand in the left foreground holds out the copper pipe piece; without a word he raps it once with a knuckle, face unchanged; under the workbench a small soft heap of sawdust; shadowy interior with side light from the open front on the left

medium shot, eye level: old Kwak on the right hangs the copper piece on a hanging scale and watches the needle swing, not looking at the boy; Dongmin on the left pours a fistful of bottle caps onto the workbench, eager face turned up to the old man; shadowy interior, side light from the open front on the left

bust shot, eye level: Dongmin on the left holds up a bottle cap so it glints, then wipes his nose with his sleeve; old Kwak on the right answers deadpan without looking up; between them in the background Eunju is not watching the scale, her eyes fixed past the workbench toward a shelf; shadowy interior, side light from the left

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: point-of-view shot from Eunju, slow push-in to a shelf where a wooden violin body with a narrow waist sits, neck broken off, one crack in the top, no strings, the only dustless thing among dusty scrap, catching the side light. Bottom: close-up of an old man's hands with bent ring and little fingers lifting it down slowly like a newborn and wiping along the crack with a soft cloth

medium shot, eye level: Dongmin on the left stands on tiptoe with his chin on the edge of the workbench, peering at the violin body; old Kwak on the right keeps wiping it with the soft cloth without looking up, mouth set; shadowy interior, side light from the open front on the left

bust shot, eye level: old Kwak speaks while his hands keep working, eyes on the violin body, face unchanged; as he finishes he raises a bent knuckle to the side of the body, about to tap it; shadowy interior, side light from the open front on the left falling on his forearms

extreme close-up, side view: Eunju's left ear and profile, head tilting to the left, eyes half-lowered; from the out-of-focus violin body in the background a tiny tap flashes as a small dot of pale light, and behind it one fainter second ring blooms from inside the hollow wood and drifts to her ear; surroundings desaturated; side light from the left

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top, short: Eunju whispers, lips barely parted, while the old man's hand freezes on the wood. Bottom, long: close-up, frontal, old Kwak looks straight at her for a long moment, face unchanged, the violin body in the same frame below his face, his bent fingers resting on the crack; quiet empty space above his head; dim interior, side light from the left

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: old Kwak drops a few plain fictional bills and coins with no real currency design into Eunju's gloved palm, then pulls his reading glasses down onto his eyes, face unchanged; Dongmin grins, drawing in the air with an imaginary crayon. Bottom: back view from inside the dim shop, the two children walk out into the bright yard; Eunju does not turn around, but her booted steps slow and she falls a step behind

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, bare hands and socks indoors (no work gloves, no rubber boots)

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: dusk exterior of the shack village, a few small windows lit warm yellow under a navy sky. Bottom: cross-section view of the two-room shack divided by a thin plywood wall; Eunju at the kerosene burner lifts her head toward a sound outside as she sets a pot on the flame; a thin wisp of briquette smoke seeps in under the door; single bare bulb light

insert close-up at the inside of the shack door: a man's long-fingered hand in a worn olive field-jacket sleeve dusted with iron filings hangs a cotton neck towel on the door handle without a word; only the hand, sleeve, towel and handle in frame; warm bulb light from inside, navy dusk showing through the door gap

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, bare hands and socks indoors (no work gloves, no rubber boots)

cut_en: medium shot, eye level, frontal view of the low folding table: Manseok sits in the center back, slightly stooped, silently eating with his eyes on his bowl; Eunju on the left holds her spoon quietly; Dongmin on the right raises his spoon high, chattering with excitement; a pot of kimchi stew bubbles in the middle; single bare bulb light from above

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, bare hands and socks indoors (no work gloves, no rubber boots)

cut_en: medium shot, eye level: Dongmin on the right taps his rice bowl with his spoon so it rings; Eunju on the left tilts her head slightly to the left without meaning to; Manseok in the center speaks flatly with his eyes on his own bowl, not looking up; bulb light from above, steam rising from the stew

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: extreme close-up of chopstick tips frozen in midair, a piece of kimchi dangling and swaying from them. Bottom: Manseok lays the chopsticks down on the low table very slowly, without a sound, head lowered, eyes hidden under the brim of his work cap, long fingers lingering on them; single bulb light from above

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, bare hands and socks indoors (no work gloves, no rubber boots)

cut_en: extreme close-up, side view: Eunju's left ear and profile in the foreground, head tilted, eyes on the closed shack door; from beyond the door one long exhaled breath arrives as a slow pale wave rippling to her ear; her face is not surprised, only quietly puzzled; Dongmin out of focus in the background still eating; surroundings desaturated; bulb light from above

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, bare hands and socks indoors (no work gloves, no rubber boots)

cut_en: full shot, high angle looking down: in the tiny side room Eunju sits cross-legged on a blanket with a palm-sized transistor radio on her knees, its paint chipped at the corners and the leather handle cracked; she looks down at it with both hands resting beside it; a single bare bulb overhead casts a small warm pool of light

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, bare hands and socks indoors (no work gloves, no rubber boots)

cut_en: extreme close-up, side view: Eunju holds the small silver tuning fork from her necklace to her left ear after tapping it on her knee, eyes closed; the fork glints under the bulb; from its tines clean, straight, evenly spaced rings of silvery white light spread into the dim room; surroundings desaturated; warm bulb light from above

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, bare hands and socks indoors (no work gloves, no rubber boots)

cut_en: close-up from above on Eunju's bare hands: she turns the screws of the radio's back panel with a coin, then with one fingertip gently nudges a tangled wire inside the open case; a loose wisp of her hair falls at her temple; warm bulb light from above

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, bare hands and socks indoors (no work gloves, no rubber boots)

cut_en: close-up, eye level, static frontal shot: Eunju holds her breath, lips slightly parted, eyes wide and still, fingers frozen on the radio dial at the bottom of the frame; from the radio speaker a soft lavender wave of light drifts up, a fainter blurred ripple folding into it and fading away together; surroundings desaturated; warm bulb light from above

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, bare hands and socks indoors (no work gloves, no rubber boots)

cut_en: medium shot, eye level: the side-room door creaks open and Dongmin crawls in on his knees, rolled up in a blanket, whispering; Eunju on the left sits on her blanket with the radio on her knees and answers quietly; the plywood wall on the right; warm bulb light from above

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, bare hands and socks indoors (no work gloves, no rubber boots)

cut_en: close-up, eye level: Dongmin's face buried in the rolled blanket so only his eyes peek out, blinking slowly as he thinks very hard, eyebrows scrunched together; the edge of Eunju's shoulder and the radio on her knee in the left foreground; small cramped room, warm bulb light from above

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, bare hands and socks indoors (no work gloves, no rubber boots)

cut_en: medium shot, high angle: Eunju on the left lowers her eyes to the radio on her knees, answering softly after a half-beat pause; Dongmin on the right, still wrapped in his blanket, rolls over and over toward the door at a voice from beyond the thin plywood wall; warm bulb light from above

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, bare hands and socks indoors (no work gloves, no rubber boots)

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into two frames in near darkness. Top: extreme close-up of a girl's knuckles knocking twice on a thin plywood wall, faint navy light grazing the grain. Bottom: cross-section view with the plywood wall in the center, Dongmin curled under his blanket in the main room on the left knocking back on the wall with his small fist, Eunju lying under her blanket in the side room on the right

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, bare hands and socks indoors (no work gloves, no rubber boots)

cut_en: close-up, eye level: Eunju's face on her pillow in near darkness, only its outline lit by faint navy light from the small window; eyes half closed; the corners of her mouth lift just slightly, lips closed, no teeth; quiet composition with dark negative space around her

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, bare hands (no work gloves)

cut_en: long shot, high angle descending from three swaying bare bulbs to the whole basement room: a few island kids in dark clothes doing homework at mismatched desks; Eunju sits beside Dongmin checking his dictation notebook; every head has just jerked up toward the stairs at a loud crash; yellow bulb light with swinging shadows

long shot, low angle from the foot of the stairs: Seonyoung sits sprawled halfway up the steep stairs, her black violin case flipped open beside her with no violin inside, sheet music sliding out and colorful candies tumbling down toward the viewer; kids' hands reach in from the bottom edge; one bus token rolls among the candies and she lunges flat on the steps to grab it; swaying yellow bulb light

medium shot, eye level: in front of the green chalkboard Seonyoung bows stiffly with her hands clasped, then straightens, pushing her round glasses up, cheeks pink, an awkward polite smile, the island kids watching from their mismatched desks in the foreground; yellow bulb light from above with soft swaying shadows

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: Dongmin on the left raises his hand high with a candy bulging in one cheek; Seonyoung on the right fumbles with her glasses, stammering. Bottom: close-up of Seonyoung laughing along with the room, but while the smile stays on her lips her eyes drop for a moment toward the floor; yellow bulb light

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: point-of-view shot from Eunju into the open violin case at the foot of the stairs, red velvet pressed into a violin-shaped hollow, only sheet music and a few candies inside, faint rosin dust. Bottom: a young woman's hands close the lid and a hollow ring of pale light spreads from the case, her fingers lingering on the latch; surroundings desaturated

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, bare hands (no work gloves)

cut_en: medium shot, side view: Seonyoung at the chalkboard on the right holds a piece of chalk up close to her glasses, staring at its split tip, eyes round with surprise; the kids at their desks still have their hands over their ears from the screech; in the back row on the left Eunju sits straight and calm, eyes on the chalk; yellow bulb light

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, bare hands (no work gloves)

cut_en: long shot, side view across the room: Seonyoung at the chalkboard on the right and Eunju in the back row on the left face each other; Dongmin in the middle has jumped up from his seat, pointing proudly at his sister; Seonyoung flinches and takes a step back, glasses askew; the other kids burst out laughing; the three bulbs swing, shadows sliding

long shot, side view along the muddy embankment road after rain: Seonyoung in a long skirt hops on one foot clutching the empty violin case to her chest, one shoe stuck deep in the mud; in the right foreground Deoksu, Eunju and Dongmin sit in a row on the bank watching, Deoksu holding up a rice crust as a bet; puddles reflecting soft afternoon light from the right

medium shot, eye level: grandma Sunrye on the right, just out from the flap of her patched soup tent, clicks her tongue and drops a pair of big black rubber boots at Seonyoung's feet; Seonyoung on the left holds up her mud-caked shoe, pushing her glasses up; in the background Deoksu glumly eats his own rice crust; soft afternoon light from the right

long shot, eye level, wide view inside the patched canvas tent: steam rising from the huge iron pot at the back; Seonyoung in baggy black rubber boots stands before the low platform handing out candies as kids crowd in, Deoksu at the very front; Eunju and Dongmin sit at the far end; Mija leans on the tent pole with arms crossed, two kids behind her; soft diffused light through the canvas

medium shot, eye level: Seonyoung in the center brings her hands together and then spreads them open as if holding something round and invisible, earnest and nervous; in the left foreground the back of Mija's shoulder and her raised chin as she cuts in; soft diffused tent light, steam haze behind

close-up, eye level: Seonyoung freezes with her mouth still open, her hands stuck mid-gesture at the bottom of the frame, eyes blinking behind her round glasses as she answers in a very small voice; soft diffused tent light, steam haze behind

long shot, eye level: the whole tent shakes with laughter, the canvas walls billowing; Mija in the center puffs out her cheeks and mimes blowing a trumpet with her fists; two kids in dark clothes beside her clutch their stomachs and fall over laughing; soft diffused tent light

medium shot, eye level: Deoksu on the left raises his hand high with a serious face, then nods solemnly; Seonyoung on the right answers in a fluster, her ears turning bright red; laughing kids around them; soft diffused tent light

medium shot over Eunju's shoulder: her left ear and cheek in the foreground, not laughing; through the raised side flap of the tent, the junk shop next door where old Kwak sits upright at his workbench with his back to us; a rhythm of pale light ripples from his sanding hand and then breaks off, leaving an empty gap; his hand frozen on the sandpaper; surroundings desaturated

medium shot, eye level: grandma Sunrye on the left bangs her ladle on the rim of the steaming iron pot, then points it out through the raised side flap; in the foreground the backs of the kids' heads all turn toward the junk shop; in the background old Kwak sits upright at his workbench with his back to everyone, not turning around; soft diffused tent light

medium shot, eye level: old Kwak's left profile in the foreground as he sits upright at his workbench sanding a piece of wood, not turning around; beyond him in the bright open doorway Seonyoung stands backlit in oversized black rubber boots, hands clasped; a few kids' heads peek in at the edge of the doorway; afternoon light from the right

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: extreme close-up of old Kwak's eyes under the reading glasses pushed up on his forehead, glancing up toward the attic for just one second. Bottom: extreme close-up of Eunju's eyes peeking in from the doorway, following his glance up to the ceiling and back down; quiet composition

medium shot, eye level from the yard: old Kwak on the left in the shade under the tin roof stays upright at his work without looking up; Seonyoung on the right starts to plead with one hand half raised, then her shoulders slump and she turns away; afternoon side light from the right

close-up over Eunju's shoulder: her left ear out of focus in the left foreground; in sharp focus old Kwak's hands sand the wood slower than before, pause, his thumb stroking once along the grain, then push again; each slow stroke sends a soft pale ripple toward her ear; surroundings desaturated; afternoon side light

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, bare hands and socks indoors (no work gloves, no rubber boots)

cut_en: medium shot from the height of the sleeping mat: Eunju lies awake under her blanket in the dark side room, eyes open, head tilted to the left toward the small window; her mother's radio by her pillow; through the window, beyond dark shack roofs, one faint yellow light from the junk shop, and from it soft pale ripples of sawing and tapping drift in; surroundings desaturated; navy night

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. bust shot, side view: old Kwak on the right plucks the strings of the can violin one by one and turns the wooden pegs; Eunju on the left, head tilted to the left, speaks quietly after a half-beat pause, eyes on the second string; the old man's eyes turn to her; golden backlight from the right

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: a white plastic scrap that was flying over the hilltop slowly settles onto the trash as the wind stops. Middle: at the scrap collection yard below, a man's hands stop mid-unload. Bottom: scavengers on the slope straighten up one by one; surroundings desaturated

extreme close-up, point-of-view shot from Eunju: the corner of old Kwak's mouth lifts very slightly on one side for an instant, lips closed, no teeth; shallow depth of field, the background out of focus where Seonyoung and the kids all stare down at the can; golden backlight from the right

medium shot, eye level: Seonyoung takes off her round glasses, wipes them on her sleeve, puts them back on, then takes them off again, lips parted as she searches for words that do not come; eyes shining; golden backlight from the right

cut_en: close-up, eye level: Eunju's face against the low golden sun, rim light on her cheek and loose hair; the corners of her mouth lift just slightly, lips closed, no teeth, eyes soft; the can violin at the bottom edge of the frame; quiet composition

long shot, eye level, wide view into the junk shop from the yard: old Kwak on the right hammers a wooden plank into a half-cut oil drum, the new instrument standing exactly as tall as Eunju, who stands beside it in the center measuring herself against it; in the left background Mija leans in the doorway with arms crossed, sneering; afternoon side light through the open front

long shot from floor level: Deoksu hugs the oil-drum cello and draws a bow across its thick string; a low heavy hum seems to spread along the floor, screws on the workbench rattling; Dongmin on the left doubles over laughing, clutching his stomach; Deoksu answers with a serious face; old Kwak watches on the right; afternoon side light

medium shot, side view: Eunju's left ear in the out-of-focus left foreground; Deoksu chews a bite of rice crust, then draws the bow again across the oil-drum cello, steadier now; from the drum a rounder, warmer ring of orange light spreads out toward her ear; surroundings desaturated; afternoon side light

medium shot, eye level: old Kwak on the right names the instrument flatly; Deoksu on the left grins shyly, droopy eyes crinkling, and hugs the oil-drum cello even tighter instead of putting it down; afternoon side light from the open front

medium shot, low angle: Dongmin lifts a paint-can drum toward the sun, its head of translucent black X-ray film glowing so a clean, cartoonish white silhouette of a waving hand skeleton with five spread fingers shows through, no medical or injury look, his mouth wide in delight; old Kwak on the right looks on; behind them a basin of soapy water and a clothesline of washed X-ray films drying; backlight from the open front

medium shot, eye level: Dongmin beats the X-ray film drum with two wooden spoons, turning to his sister with a gap-toothed grin; Eunju on the left tilts her head to the left, listening; he keeps drumming faster and faster, bouncing on his toes; afternoon side light

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: Mija in the doorway, arms crossed and sneering, as old Kwak holds out a bent drainpipe with a funnel at its end. Bottom: Mija blows into the pipe with cheeks puffed out, her face turning as red as her top, while Dongmin rolls on the floor laughing; afternoon side light

extreme close-up, side view: Eunju's left ear and profile in the left foreground, head tilting to the left; in the background the funnel joint of Mija's drainpipe trumpet, and from a small gap on the left side of the joint a thin thread of teal light hisses out and drifts to her ear; surroundings desaturated; afternoon side light

medium shot, eye level: Eunju on the left points calmly at the funnel joint; Mija in the center glares at her; old Kwak on the right peers at the joint, wraps one more turn of wire around it and patches it with a scrap of rubber, then hands it back; afternoon side light

long shot, eye level, wide exterior of the junk shop: a blast from inside makes the corrugated tin roof jump; a flock of crows bursts up all at once from the direction of the big hill into the hazy beige sky; on the left grandma Sunrye bursts out of her tent clutching a ladle; through the open front Mija is small, blowing the pipe

medium shot, eye level: Mija stares down at the drainpipe trumpet in her hands, eyes sparkling; old Kwak on the right names it deadpan; Mija protests loudly with her mouth wide open but clutches the pipe tight against her chest like a treasure; afternoon side light from the open front

medium shot, eye level: Mija on the right, hugging the pipe, mutters toward the ground without looking at Eunju; Eunju on the left answers plainly after a half-beat pause; Mija's head snaps up, chin high, with a proud grin; afternoon side light

insert shot: a wall calendar inside the junk shop, one page being flipped over from one month to the next, the dates as unreadable blank grid squares suggesting text; rusty scrap and hanging tools blurred around it; flat daytime shade of the shop interior

medium shot, eye level: Seonyoung holds the stick up with both hands like something fragile, pushing her glasses up, about to count, then flaps a hand in panic; on the left Dongmin is already pounding his drum with a huge gap-toothed grin; soft diffused tent light

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: Eunju bows the can violin with concentration, head tilted, straining to hear, crowded on all sides by the clamor of the other instruments. Bottom: men at the low tables clap their hands over their ears while grandma Sunrye calmly stirs the steaming iron pot with her ladle, ears uncovered; soft canvas light

medium shot, eye level: Seonyoung unrolls a sheet of paper with a shining gold border, unreadable blank columns suggesting text, and traces the lines with a finger, hopeful and nervous; Mija on the right, still holding the drainpipe trumpet, stares with wide eyes; the gold border glints in the tent shade

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: Deoksu asks with a hopeful face while Seonyoung fumbles for an answer and the other kids laugh. Bottom: point-of-view shot from Eunju, the glinting gold border of the paper at the top, her gaze lowering to the can violin held in her own arms; soft canvas light

tall panel split horizontally into two frames, the man's face never in frame. Top: low shot on the muddy rutted embankment road, polished black shoes tiptoeing around the mud, a gray suit sleeve and a hand holding a manila envelope under the arm. Bottom: at the notice board, the same hand pins a gray sheet right beside the gold-bordered paper; cool low morning sun from the left, dew on the reeds

tall panel split horizontally into three frames, the man's face never in frame. Top: extreme close-up, a thumbtack slips from his fingers into the mud, then the hand picks it up and wipes it with a white handkerchief. Middle: the hand presses the last corner, then the same handkerchief rises out of the top of the frame toward the forehead. Bottom: static shot of the board as a small gray-suited back walks away down the road

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: long shot, Eunju walks empty-handed along the rutted embankment road toward the island entrance, the tin roof of the junk shop ahead. Bottom: close-up of her empty gloved hand as she walks, fingers curled in the shape of a bow grip, index finger on top and thumb beneath; cool morning light from the left

medium shot over Eunju's shoulder: she has stopped in front of the weathered plywood notice board; two papers are pinned side by side, on the left a sheet with a shining gold border, on the right a gray rough-paper notice with a red seal stamp, both with unreadable blank columns suggesting text; cool morning light from the left

tall panel split horizontally into two frames, product-like insert shots. Top: the gold-bordered contest notice, plain context, unreadable blank columns suggesting text. Bottom: the gray rough-paper clearance notice with unreadable blank columns suggesting text, and an extreme close-up of a round red seal stamp with no legible characters; flat cool morning light from the left

tall panel split into five horizontal strips that grow thinner toward the middle: Eunju's eyes darting left, a strip of the gold-bordered paper, her eyes darting right, a strip of the gray notice. The last and largest strip is a memory insert on the trash slope: a gloved hand sorting scrap, dropping useful pieces into a sack and setting the rest aside on a pile

medium shot, side view beside the board: the river wind makes both papers tremble together; Eunju tilts her head to the left, then a little further, and closes her eyes; from the gold-bordered paper and from the gray notice two identical pale rings spread at exactly the same size, alternating and overlapping, neither larger; surroundings desaturated; cool morning light from the left

close-up, eye level, static: Eunju opens her eyes, head still tilted to the left and not coming back, lips closed, eyebrows faintly drawn together, the face of someone whose ear has found no answer for the first time; cool morning light from the left; the lower third of the panel fades into solid black
